entities.summary: Cipriano José Barata de Almeida was a Brazilian medical doctor and politician who was in favor of Brazilian independence. He was a founding member of the Masonic lodge "Knights of the Light". He was also a journalist who started a newspaper in Portugal called the Sentinel of Liberty.
